text: And the only horse that's got the least possible chance to win. Who's you betting on, Mandy? Oh, I've got fourteen dollars on Little Pony by the name of Mud Turtle. He's a hundred to one shot. And a cross-eyed boy. Surely he won't get one. But a humpback coon. Do you want me to take a chance? Yeah, settle it. Get off, get off. Here he goes, Mandy, stricken lightning in the leaf.
